observations: Large solar panel standing vertically against a wall.
Silver aluminum frame with a white top rail.
Blue solar cells arranged in a 3x3 grid.
Two black mounting brackets attached to the frame.
Watermark 'Jiji' and 'Jiji.ng' visible across the center.
No brand name, model number, or specification label is visible on the front of the panel.

claims.evidence: No specification label is visible in photo 0 to confirm wattage or cell type.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No battery is visible in the photo; the claim is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panel may be a lower wattage model or a non-550W unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be non-functional or have internal cell damage.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The panel may be a poly-fused cell (PFC) rather than monocrystalline (mono).
risks.proof: A photo of the cell surface showing the characteristic diamond pattern of monocrystalline cells.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
Photo of the cell surface to confirm it is monocrystalline.
Video of a multimeter test showing the panel's voltage output.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
